lesson.title: 多项式函数的方程与图像
lesson.description: 第3章：零点、根与截距，重数、符号区间、手绘图与变换，以及完整实际模型与节后练习。

en.title: Equations and Graphs of Polynomial Functions
en.description: Chapter 3: zeros, roots and intercepts, multiplicity, sign intervals, hand sketches, transformations, modelling, and every section exercise.

concepts.title: 零点、根与截距
concepts.summary: 目标：联系零点、方程的根与横截距；不用技术勾画多项式；建立并求解实际模型。$f(a)=0$ 当且仅当 $a$ 是方程 $f(x)=0$ 的根，图像上有点 $(a,0)$。

method.title: 分解并令因子为零
method.body: 使用因式定理和整数零点定理分解，然后分别解各因子等于零。

pitfalls: 零点和根是数；横截距是图像上的点。本节方程求实数解。

en.title: Zeros, roots and intercepts
en.summary: Focus: relate zeros, equation roots and x-intercepts; sketch without technology; model and solve problems. $f(a)=0$ exactly when $a$ is a root of $f(x)=0$, giving the point $(a,0)$ on the graph.

method.title: Factor and set factors equal to zero
method.body: Use the factor theorem and integral zero theorem to factor, then solve each factor equal to zero.

method.title: Mark intercepts
method.body: Write x-intercepts as $(a,0)$ and the y-intercept as $(0,f(0))$.

pitfalls: A zero or root is a number; an x-intercept is a point. Equations in this section are solved over the real numbers.

concepts.title: 零点重数与局部形状
concepts.summary: 若 $(x-a)^n$ 是重复因子且其余因子在 $a$ 不为零，则零点 $a$ 的重数为 $n$（也称 order）。奇重数处穿过横轴并变号；偶重数处接触横轴且不变号。

method.title: 数重复因子
method.body: 把所有 $(x-a)$ 因子合并，指数就是重数。所有实根的重数和不超过次数。

method.title: 判断穿越或相切
method.body: 重数1通常斜穿；奇重数大于1时平坦穿越；偶重数时折返。靠近 $a$ 的形状类似 $c(x-a)^n$，其中 $c\ne0$。

method.title: 正文示例：重复因子
method.body: $f(x)=(x-1)(x-1)(x+2)=(x-1)^2(x+2)$ 的零点1为二重、$-2$ 为一重。图像在1接触横轴但不变号，在 $-2$ 穿越并变号。

pitfalls: 一张草图一般只能确定最低可能重数，不能单凭穿越断言重数恰为1。

en.title: Multiplicity and local shape
en.summary: If $(x-a)^n$ is the repeated factor and the remaining factor is nonzero at $a$, the zero has multiplicity (order) $n$. Odd multiplicities cross and change sign; even multiplicities touch without changing sign.

method.title: Count repeated factors
method.body: Combine all factors $(x-a)$; the exponent is the multiplicity. The sum of real-root multiplicities cannot exceed the degree.

method.title: Predict crossing or touching
method.body: Multiplicity 1 normally crosses with nonzero slope; odd multiplicity greater than 1 crosses with flattening; even multiplicity turns back. Near $a$, the shape resembles $c(x-a)^n$, with $c\ne0$.

method.title: Text example: repeated factors
method.body: $f(x)=(x-1)(x-1)(x+2)=(x-1)^2(x+2)$ has zero 1 of multiplicity 2 and zero $-2$ of multiplicity 1. It touches without a sign change at 1 and crosses with a sign change at $-2$.

pitfalls: A sketch usually determines only the least possible multiplicity; crossing alone does not establish multiplicity exactly 1.

concepts.title: 符号区间与手绘图
concepts.summary: 次数的奇偶与首项系数决定端点方向；截距、重数和区间测试共同确定草图。零点处函数既不为正也不为负。

method.title: 整理整体特征
method.body: 求次数、首项系数、横截距和纵截距。奇次两端反向，偶次两端同向；正首项右端向上，负首项右端向下。

method.title: 分区间测符号
method.body: 按零点分区间，在每段取内部测试值；奇重数处变号，偶重数处不变。

method.title: 平滑连接
method.body: 标出截距，按端点方向和穿越/相切行为平滑连接，必要时算额外点。

pitfalls: 零点和符号未必唯一确定纵向比例。图题若无额外标注，只写最低次数的一族。

en.title: Sign intervals and sketches
en.summary: Degree parity and the leading coefficient determine end behaviour. Combine intercepts, multiplicity and interval tests to sketch. At a zero the function is neither positive nor negative.

method.title: Find global features
method.body: Find degree, leading coefficient and both intercept types. Odd-degree ends oppose, even-degree ends agree; a positive leading coefficient rises on the right and a negative one falls.

method.title: Test signs between zeros
method.body: Split the real line at its zeros and test an interior point in each interval. Sign changes at odd multiplicities and stays at even multiplicities.

method.title: Join smoothly
method.body: Plot the intercepts, respect end behaviour and crossing/touching, and add evaluated points when helpful.

pitfalls: Zeros and signs may not uniquely fix vertical scale. Without another labelled value, give a least-degree family.

concepts.title: 幂函数的变换
concepts.summary: $y=a[b(x-h)]^n+k$ 来自 $y=x^n$。当 $b\ne0$，点映射为 $(x,y)\mapsto(x/b+h,ay+k)$。先处理伸缩与反射，再平移。

method.title: 辨认参数
method.body: $|a|$ 是竖直伸缩因子，$a<0$ 关于横轴反射；$1/|b|$ 是水平伸缩因子，$b<0$ 关于纵轴反射。

method.title: 平移并描点
method.body: 向右 $h$、向上 $k$（负值反向）。把已知点逐个映射并用平滑曲线连接。

en.title: Transformations of power functions
en.summary: $y=a[b(x-h)]^n+k$ comes from $y=x^n$. For $b\ne0$, the point map is $(x,y)\mapsto(x/b+h,ay+k)$. Apply stretches and reflections before translations.

method.title: Identify parameters
method.body: $|a|$ is the vertical scale, with reflection in the x-axis for $a<0$. $1/|b|$ is the horizontal scale, with reflection in the y-axis for $b<0$.

method.title: Translate and plot
method.body: Translate right $h$ and up $k$ (negative values reverse direction). Map known points and join them smoothly.

pitfalls: The horizontal scale is $1/|b|$, not $|b|$. $x+2=x-(-2)$ means left 2.

concepts.title: 实际模型与有效解
concepts.summary: 把体积、面积或整数关系写成多项式方程，再把代数解与实际限制取交集。

method.title: 定义变量与范围
method.body: 写出各尺寸及其单位，要求长度为正；连续整数要说明间距和整数条件。

method.title: 建立方程并求解
method.body: 使用 $V=lwh$、面积差或乘积关系，分解或用技术求根，给近似值加约等号。

method.title: 代回检验
method.body: 检验全部条件、单位与有效范围，舍去不合理根。

pitfalls: 不能因体积等式成立就保留负尺寸。开放式图形可以有多个等价答案。

en.title: Models and admissible solutions
en.summary: Write the volume, area or integer relationship as a polynomial equation, then intersect its algebraic solutions with the physical constraints.

method.title: Define variables and restrictions
method.body: Express each dimension with units and require positive lengths. For consecutive integers state the spacing and integer restriction.

method.title: Build and solve the equation
method.body: Use $V=lwh$, an area difference or a product relationship; factor or find roots numerically, and mark approximations.

method.title: Check in context
method.body: Substitute back, verify units and all conditions, and reject inadmissible roots.

pitfalls: A volume equality does not justify negative dimensions. Open graph constructions may have several equivalent answers.

questions.prompt: 飞机手提行李的宽比高少17 cm，长最多比高多15 cm。最大体积可表示为 $V(h)=h^3-2h^2-255h$（cm³），$h$ 为高（cm）。若行李舱最大容量为50 600 cm³，如何确定手提行李的最大尺寸？

en.prompt: On an airplane, carry-on baggage has width 17 cm less than its height and length no more than 15 cm greater than its height. Its maximum volume is $V(h)=h^3-2h^2-255h$, where $h$ is the height in centimetres. If the overhead compartment has a maximum volume of 50 600 cm³, how could you determine the maximum dimensions of the carry-on bags?

steps.title: Set up the maximum-volume equation
steps.body: The maximum length is $h+15$ and width is $h-17$, requiring $h>17$. Thus $h(h-17)(h+15)=50600$.

steps.title: Factor and check
steps.body: $h^3-2h^2-255h-50600=(h-40)(h^2+38h+1265)$. The quadratic discriminant is $38^2-4(1265)=-3616<0$, so the only real root is $40$.

steps.title: Recover dimensions
steps.body: Height 40 cm, width 23 cm and length 55 cm give $40(23)(55)=50600$ cm³.

en.answer: Height 40 cm, width 23 cm, length 55 cm.
en.label: Opening problem

questions.label: 开篇问题

questions.prompt: (a) 用图像技术画出 $f(x)=x^4+x^3-10x^2-4x+24$。(b) 从图读出横截距。(c) 分解 $f(x)$，再由因式求零点。 边栏：这个多项式有哪些可能的整数因子（用于试整数零点）？

steps.title: 整数零点候选
steps.body: 首项系数为1，常数24，因此整数零点候选是24的整数因子 $\pm1,\pm2,\pm3,\pm4,\pm6,\pm8,\pm12,\pm24$。测试得到 $-3,-2,2$；候选不代表全都是零点。

en.prompt: (a) Graph $f(x)=x^4+x^3-10x^2-4x+24$ using graphing technology. (b) Determine the x-intercepts from the graph. (c) Factor $f(x)$, then use the factors to determine its zeros. Sidebar: What are the possible integral factors of this polynomial?

steps.title: (a) Plot the function
steps.body: $f(-4)=72,f(-3)=0,f(-2)=0,f(0)=24,f(2)=0,f(3)=30$. Both ends rise and the curve touches the x-axis at $x=2$.

steps.title: (b)(c) Factors and intercepts
steps.body: Testing $-3,-2,2$ gives $f(x)=(x+3)(x+2)(x-2)^2$. Expanding $(x^2+5x+6)(x^2-4x+4)$ recovers the original. The intercepts are $(-3,0),(-2,0),(2,0)$; zeros are $-3,-2,2$, with 2 repeated twice.

steps.title: Candidates for integral zeros
steps.body: The leading coefficient is 1 and constant is 24, so candidate integral zeros are the integral factors of 24: $\pm1,\pm2,\pm3,\pm4,\pm6,\pm8,\pm12,\pm24$. Testing gives $-3,-2,2$; not every candidate is a zero.

en.label: Investigate / Reflect 1

questions.label: 探究 / 反思 1

questions.prompt: (a) 令 $f(x)=x^4+x^3-10x^2-4x+24$ 等于0，解 $x^4+x^3-10x^2-4x+24=0$ 求根。(b) 方程的根与函数图像的横截距有什么关系？

steps.title: (b) 比较坐标
steps.body: 每个根都是横截距的横坐标：$f(a)=0$ 对应点 $(a,0)$。

questions.answer: (a) $-3,-2,2$（2为二重根）；(b) 根是横截距的横坐标。

en.prompt: (a) Set $f(x)=x^4+x^3-10x^2-4x+24$ equal to 0 and solve $x^4+x^3-10x^2-4x+24=0$ for its roots. (b) What do you notice about the roots of the equation and the x-intercepts of the graph?

steps.title: (a) Apply the zero-product property
steps.body: $(x+3)(x+2)(x-2)^2=0$ gives $x=-3,-2,2$, with 2 of multiplicity 2.

steps.title: (b) Compare coordinates
steps.body: Each root is the x-coordinate of an x-intercept: $f(a)=0$ corresponds to $(a,0)$.

en.answer: (a) $-3,-2,2$ (2 is double); (b) roots are the x-coordinates of the intercepts.
en.label: Investigate / Reflect 2

questions.label: 探究 / 反思 2

questions.prompt: 函数的零点、相应图像的横截距及相应多项式方程的根之间有什么关系？

steps.title: 从函数值为零解释
steps.body: 若 $f(a)=0$，则 $a$ 是函数的零点，也满足方程 $f(x)=0$，因此是其根；图像包含点 $(a,0)$，故该点为横截距。反之，横截距纵坐标为0，所以也给出零点与根。

questions.answer: 零点 = 根 = 横截距的横坐标。

en.prompt: What is the relationship between the zeros of a function, the x-intercepts of the corresponding graph, and the roots of the polynomial equation?

steps.title: Use the zero function value
steps.body: If $f(a)=0$, then $a$ is a zero and satisfies $f(x)=0$, so it is a root. The graph contains $(a,0)$, an x-intercept. Conversely, an x-intercept has y-coordinate 0 and therefore yields a zero and a root.

en.answer: Zero = root = x-coordinate of an x-intercept.
en.label: Investigate / Reflect 3

questions.label: 探究 / 反思 3

questions.prompt: 参照探究1的图。横截距把横轴分成四段，抄写并完成表格：写出各区间并判断 $f(x)$ 为正（横轴上方）或负（横轴下方）。表中首段为 $x<-3$，符号为正。

en.prompt: Refer to the graph from step 1. The x-intercepts divide the x-axis into four intervals. Copy and complete the table with each interval and whether $f(x)$ is positive (above the x-axis) or negative (below it). The first column is $x<-3$, positive.

steps.title: Complete the table and exclude zeros
steps.body: Positive: $(-\infty,-3),(-2,2),(2,\infty)$; negative: $(-3,-2)$. At $-3,-2,2$ the value is 0.

en.label: Investigate / Reflect 4

questions.label: 探究 / 反思 4

questions.prompt: (a) 图像从横轴一侧穿到另一侧时，$f(x)$ 的符号怎样变化？(b) 有两个相同零点时，图像怎样表现？

steps.title: (a) 符号改变
steps.body: 横轴上方 $f(x)>0$，下方 $f(x)<0$，所以穿越时符号改变。

steps.title: (b) 二重根处相切
steps.body: 两个相同零点产生 $(x-a)^2$；在 $a$ 两侧该因子均为正，故图像接触横轴后返回同侧（假定恰为二重根、其余因子非零）。

questions.answer: (a) 变号；(b) 二重零点处相切、不变号。

en.prompt: (a) What happens to the sign of $f(x)$ if the graph crosses from one side of the x-axis to the other? (b) How does the graph behave if there are two identical zeros?

steps.title: (a) The sign changes
steps.body: Above the x-axis $f(x)>0$ and below it $f(x)<0$, so crossing changes sign.

steps.title: (b) A double zero touches
steps.body: Two identical zeros produce $(x-a)^2$. This factor is positive on both sides of $a$, so the graph touches and returns to the same side (for multiplicity exactly 2 and a nonzero remaining factor).

en.answer: (a) It changes sign; (b) it touches without changing sign at a double zero.
en.label: Investigate / Reflect 5

questions.label: 探究 / 反思 5

questions.prompt: 不用图形计算器，求 $f(x)=-x^3-5x^2-3x+9$ 的次数、首项系数的符号、零点、纵截距、正值区间和负值区间。

steps.title: 判定符号
steps.body: $-(x-1)$ 在 $x<1$ 为正，而平方项除 $-3$ 外为正；所以正区间为 $(-\infty,-3)\cup(-3,1)$，负区间为 $(1,\infty)$。

en.prompt: Without using a graphing calculator, determine the degree, sign of the leading coefficient, zeros, y-intercept, positive intervals and negative intervals of $f(x)=-x^3-5x^2-3x+9$.

steps.title: Read the features
steps.body: Degree 3; leading coefficient $-1<0$; zeros $-3$ (multiplicity 2) and 1 (multiplicity 1); $f(0)=9$, giving $(0,9)$.

steps.title: Determine signs
steps.body: $-(x-1)>0$ for $x<1$, while the square is positive except at $-3$. Thus positive on $(-\infty,-3)\cup(-3,1)$ and negative on $(1,\infty)$.

en.answer: Degree 3, negative leading coefficient; zeros $-3$ (double), 1; y-intercept $(0,9)$; positive for $x<1$, $x\ne-3$; negative for $x>1$.
en.label: Investigate / Reflect 6

questions.label: 探究 / 反思 6

questions.prompt: 利用探究6的特征勾画函数。再用技术画图，并与手绘结果比较。

steps.title: 连接并比较
steps.body: 在 $-3$ 接触横轴后仍在上方，在1穿到下方。技术图应有相同截距、相切/穿越与端点方向；手绘不要求精确极值位置。

en.prompt: Use the characteristics from step 6 to sketch the graph. Graph using technology and compare with the hand sketch.

steps.title: Plot points and ends
steps.body: For $-(x-1)(x+3)^2$, plot $(-3,0),(1,0),(0,9)$. A negative cubic rises left and falls right.

steps.title: Join and compare
steps.body: Touch at $-3$ while staying above the axis, then cross below at 1. The technology graph agrees in intercepts, touching/crossing and ends; the hand sketch need not locate extrema precisely.

en.answer: Rise on the left, touch at $-3$, pass through $(0,9)$, cross at 1 and fall on the right.
en.label: Investigate / Reflect 7

questions.label: 探究 / 反思 7

questions.prompt: 说明如何利用横截距、纵截距、首项系数的符号和次数勾画多项式图像。

steps.title: 确定两端
steps.body: 先由次数奇偶及首项正负确定左右端方向。

steps.title: 标点并决定穿越
steps.body: 标出横截距与纵截距；从因式读重数，奇重数穿越，偶重数相切；测试零点间的符号。

steps.title: 连接与检查
steps.body: 平滑连接各段，需要时计算额外点；检查符号及端点均符合。

questions.answer: 端点 → 截距 → 重数与符号 → 平滑连接并核查。

en.prompt: Describe how to sketch a polynomial using the x-intercepts, y-intercept, sign of the leading coefficient and degree.

steps.title: Determine the ends
steps.body: Use degree parity and the sign of the leading coefficient to determine the left and right ends.

steps.title: Plot and decide crossings
steps.body: Plot both intercept types, read multiplicities from factors, cross at odd multiplicities and touch at even ones, and test signs between zeros.

steps.title: Join and check
steps.body: Join the pieces smoothly, evaluate extra points if needed, and check every interval sign and both ends.

en.answer: Ends → intercepts → multiplicity and signs → smooth connection and checking.
en.label: Investigate / Reflect 8

questions.label: 探究 / 反思 8

questions.prompt: 对原图 (a)、(b)，分别确定最低可能次数、首项系数符号、横截距与最低次数函数的因式，以及函数为正和为负的区间。 边栏：(a) 各横截距的重数能否不是1？(b) 各横截距的重数能否不是1或2？

steps.title: (a) 读穿越、次数与因式
steps.body: 图在 $-4,-2,2$ 都穿越，最低重数各为1，最低次数 $1+1+1=3$。左下右上，首项系数正。最低次数的一族为 $A(x+4)(x+2)(x-2)$，$A>0$；因式为 $x+4,x+2,x-2$。

steps.title: (a) 判符号
steps.body: 从最右侧正值起，每次穿越变号。正：$(-4,-2)\cup(2,\infty)$；负：$(-\infty,-4)\cup(-2,2)$。

steps.title: (b) 读穿越与相切
steps.body: 在 $-5,-1$ 穿越，在4相切；最低重数为1、1、2，最低次数4。两端向下，首项系数负。最低次数的一族为 $-A(x+5)(x+1)(x-4)^2$，$A>0$。

steps.title: 最低可能值与更高重数
steps.body: 穿越的零点必须为奇重数，因此一般形状可对应1、3、5等；相切零点为偶重数，可对应2、4、6等。最低次数解取最小允许值。图上若明确显示非零斜率，则该零点重数确为1；平坦穿越提示较高奇重数。

en.prompt: For each graph (a) and (b), determine the least possible degree, the sign of the leading coefficient, the x-intercepts and factors of the function with least possible degree, and the positive and negative intervals. Sidebar: (a) Could the multiplicity of each x-intercept be something other than 1? (b) Could the multiplicities be something other than 1 or 2?

steps.title: (a) Read crossings, degree and factors
steps.body: The curve crosses at $-4,-2,2$, giving least multiplicity 1 at each and least degree $1+1+1=3$. It falls left and rises right, so the leading coefficient is positive. The least-degree family is $A(x+4)(x+2)(x-2)$, $A>0$, with factors $x+4,x+2,x-2$.

steps.title: (a) Determine signs
steps.body: Start positive at the right; each crossing reverses sign. Positive: $(-4,-2)\cup(2,\infty)$; negative: $(-\infty,-4)\cup(-2,2)$.

steps.title: (b) Read crossings and touching
steps.body: Cross at $-5,-1$ and touch at 4: least multiplicities 1,1,2 give degree 4. Both ends fall, so the leading coefficient is negative. A least-degree family is $-A(x+5)(x+1)(x-4)^2$, $A>0$.

steps.title: (b) Determine signs
steps.body: Positive on $(-5,-1)$; negative on $(-\infty,-5)\cup(-1,4)\cup(4,\infty)$. Touching at 4 does not change sign.

steps.title: Least possible and larger multiplicities
steps.body: A crossing zero has odd multiplicity, allowing 1,3,5 and so on when only crossing is known. A touching zero has even multiplicity, allowing 2,4,6 and so on. Least-degree models use the smallest allowed values. If nonzero slope is clear, the multiplicity is exactly 1; flattened crossing indicates a higher odd multiplicity.

en.answer: (a) Least degree 3, positive leading coefficient, intercepts $(-4,0),(-2,0),(2,0)$. (b) Least degree 4, negative leading coefficient, intercepts $(-5,0),(-1,0),(4,0)$, least multiplicity 2 at 4. Sign intervals are shown in the steps.
en.label: Example 1

questions.label: 教材例题 1

questions.prompt: 对给定图，求最低可能次数、首项系数符号、横截距与最低次数函数的因式，以及正负区间。

steps.title: 读重数与端点
steps.body: 在 $-2$ 接触横轴、在3穿越；最低重数分别为2、1，所以最低次数3。左上右下，首项系数负。

questions.answer: 最低3次，首项负；因式 $(x+2)^2,x-3$，零点 $-2$（最低二重）、3；符号如步骤。

en.prompt: For the given graph, determine the least possible degree, sign of the leading coefficient, x-intercepts and factors of the function with least possible degree, and its positive and negative intervals.

steps.title: Read multiplicities and ends
steps.body: The curve touches at $-2$ and crosses at 3; least multiplicities 2 and 1 give least degree 3. It rises left and falls right, so the leading coefficient is negative.

steps.title: Write factors and signs
steps.body: A least-degree family is $-A(x+2)^2(x-3)$, $A>0$. Intercepts: $(-2,0),(3,0)$; positive on $(-\infty,-2)\cup(-2,3)$ and negative on $(3,\infty)$.

en.answer: Least degree 3, negative leading coefficient; factors $(x+2)^2,x-3$, zeros $-2$ (at least double) and 3; signs as above.

en.prompt: Sketch each polynomial function: (a) $y=(x-1)(x+2)(x+3)$; (b) $f(x)=-(x+2)^3(x-4)$; (c) $y=-2x^3+6x-4$. (c) How does factoring out the common factor help, why is one coefficient zero, and how can multiplication check the factorization?

steps.title: (a) Factor and find zeros
steps.body: $(x-1)(x+2)(x+3)=(x-1)(x+2)(x+3)$. Set each factor to zero: -3 (multiplicity 1); -2 (multiplicity 1); 1 (multiplicity 1).

steps.title: (a) Degree, ends and intercepts
steps.body: Degree 3, leading coefficient $1$: falls left and rises right. Zeros: -3 (multiplicity 1); -2 (multiplicity 1); 1 (multiplicity 1); x-intercepts have x-coordinates $-3,-2,1$; y-intercept $(0,-6)$.

steps.title: (a) Signs and sketch
steps.body: Positive on $(-3,-2)\cup(1,\infty)$; negative on $(-\infty,-3)\cup(-2,1)$. Cross at $-3,-2,1$; join smoothly through the y-intercept with the stated end behaviour.

steps.title: (b) Factor and find zeros
steps.body: $-(x+2)^3(x-4)=-(x+2)^3(x-4)$. Set each factor to zero: -2 (multiplicity 3); 4 (multiplicity 1).

steps.title: (b) Degree, ends and intercepts
steps.body: Degree 4, leading coefficient $-1$: falls at both ends. Zeros: -2 (multiplicity 3); 4 (multiplicity 1); x-intercepts have x-coordinates $-2,4$; y-intercept $(0,32)$.

steps.title: (b) Signs and sketch
steps.body: Positive on $(-2,4)$; negative on $(-\infty,-2)\cup(4,\infty)$. Cross at $-2,4$; join smoothly through the y-intercept with the stated end behaviour.

steps.title: (c) Factor and find zeros
steps.body: $-2x^3+6x-4=-2(x-1)^2(x+2)$. Set each factor to zero: -2 (multiplicity 1); 1 (multiplicity 2).

steps.title: (c) Degree, ends and intercepts
steps.body: Degree 3, leading coefficient $-2$: rises left and falls right. Zeros: -2 (multiplicity 1); 1 (multiplicity 2); x-intercepts have x-coordinates $-2,1$; y-intercept $(0,-4)$.

steps.title: (c) Signs and sketch
steps.body: Positive on $(-\infty,-2)$; negative on $(-2,1)\cup(1,\infty)$. Cross at $-2$; touch at $1$; join smoothly through the y-intercept with the stated end behaviour.

steps.title: (b) Extra points and a triple zero
steps.body: $f(2)=-(4)^3(-2)=128$ and $f(3)=-(5)^3(-1)=125$ help locate the height and position of the hump. Near $-2$, $-(x-4)$ is about 6, so $f(x)$ resembles $6(x+2)^3$: a flattened crossing with a sign change.

steps.title: (c) Common factor, missing term and multiplication
steps.body: Factoring out $-2$ leaves the monic $x^3-3x+2$, simplifying trial roots. Its missing $x^2$ term requires coefficients $1,0,-3,2$. Check: $(x-1)^2(x+2)=(x^2-2x+1)(x+2)=x^3+0x^2-3x+2$; multiplying by $-2$ gives $-2x^3+6x-4$.

en.prompt: Bill is preparing an ice sculpture from a block 3 ft wide, 4 ft high and 5 ft long. He removes the same amount from each of the three dimensions to reduce its volume to 24 ft³. (a) Write a polynomial function to model the situation. (b) How much should he remove from each dimension?

steps.title: (a) Define the model
steps.body: Let $x$ ft be removed from each dimension, with $0\le x<3$. New dimensions are $3-x,4-x,5-x$; $V(x)=(3-x)(4-x)(5-x)=-x^3+12x^2-47x+60$.

steps.title: Exclude other roots and check
steps.body: The quadratic discriminant is $121-144=-23<0$. The only real root $x=1$ is admissible; new dimensions $2,3,4$ ft give $2(3)(4)=24$ ft³. The graphs of $V(x)$ and $y=24$ intersect at $(1,24)$.

en.answer: (a) $V(x)=(3-x)(4-x)(5-x)$, $0\le x<3$. (b) Remove 1 ft from each dimension.

steps.title: (a) Model
steps.body: Let the least integer be $n$. $P(n)=n(n+1)(n+2)=n^3+3n^2+2n$; solve $P(n)=-210$ for integer $n$.

steps.title: (b) Factor and solve
steps.body: $n^3+3n^2+2n+210=(n+7)(n^2-4n+30)$. Its quadratic discriminant is $16-120=-104<0$, so $n=-7$.

en.prompt: (a) Given $y=x^3$, list the parameters of the transformed polynomial $y=(\frac12(x-2))^3-3$. (b) Describe how each parameter transforms $y=x^3$. (c) Determine the domain and range of the transformed function.

steps.title: (a) Compare with standard form
steps.body: Comparing with $y=a[b(x-h)]^3+k$ gives $a=1,b=1/2,h=2,k=-3$.

steps.title: (b) Describe the mapping
steps.body: Horizontal stretch by 2, right 2, down 3; no vertical stretch or reflection. Map $(x,y)\mapsto(2x+2,y-3)$, for example $(0,0)\mapsto(2,-3)$.

steps.title: (c) Domain and range
steps.body: A nonzero cubic is defined for every real $x$ and extends to both positive and negative infinity. Both domain and range are $\mathbb R$.

en.answer: (a) $a=1,b=1/2,h=2,k=-3$; (b) horizontal stretch 2, right 2, down 3; (c) $D=R=\mathbb R$.

exercises.prompt: Saanich Commonwealth Place 的比赛泳池为长方体，体积2100 m³。深为 $x$ m、长为 $25x$ m、宽为 $10x+1$ m。求实际尺寸。
exercises.answer: 深2 m，长50 m，宽21 m。

en.prompt: The competition swimming pool at Saanich Commonwealth Place is a rectangular prism with volume 2100 m³. Its dimensions are $x$ metres deep, $25x$ metres long and $10x+1$ metres wide. What are the actual dimensions?

steps.title: Factor and find the real root
steps.body: Substituting 2 gives $80+4-84=0$. Thus $(x-2)(10x^2+21x+42)=0$; the quadratic discriminant is $441-1680=-1239<0$. The only real root is $x=2$.

steps.title: Recover and verify dimensions
steps.body: Depth 2 m, length 50 m, width 21 m; $2(50)(21)=2100$ m³, all positive.

en.answer: Depth 2 m, length 50 m, width 21 m.

exercises.prompt: 宽 $x$ ft 的木栈道围绕一个宽30 ft、长40 ft 的长方形池塘。池塘与栈道总面积2000 ft²，求栈道宽度。

steps.title: 选有效根并检查
steps.body: $x=-40$ 不符合正宽度；$x=5$，外部为40 ft乘50 ft，面积2000 ft²。

exercises.answer: 栈道宽5 ft。

en.prompt: A boardwalk $x$ feet wide surrounds a rectangular pond 30 ft wide and 40 ft long. The combined area of pond and boardwalk is 2000 ft². Find the boardwalk width.

steps.title: Write the outside dimensions
steps.body: Each dimension gains $x$ on both sides: $(30+2x)(40+2x)=2000$, $x>0$.

steps.title: Choose and check the admissible root
steps.body: $x=-40$ cannot be a positive width. For $x=5$, the outside is 40 ft by 50 ft, area 2000 ft².

en.answer: The boardwalk is 5 ft wide.

exercises.prompt: 对每个多项式函数确定最低次数的方程，并勾图：(a) 三次函数，零点 $-3$（重数2）与2，纵截距 $-18$；(b) 五次函数，零点 $-1$（重数3）与2（重数2），纵截距4；(c) 四次函数，首项系数负，零点 $-2$（重数2）、3（重数2），常数项 $-6$。

steps.title: (a) 由纵截距求比例
steps.body: 按指定重数写 $f(x)=A(x+3)^2(x-2)$；令 $x=0$ 得 $-18A=-18$，故 $A=1$。重数和正好为要求次数。

steps.title: (a) 次数、端点及截距
steps.body: 次数 3，首项系数 $1$，左下、右上。零点与重数：-3（重数2）；2（重数1）；横截距的横坐标为 $-3,2$；纵截距为 $(0,-18)$。

steps.title: (a) 符号与草图
steps.body: 正值区间：$(2,\infty)$；负值区间：$(-\infty,-3)\cup(-3,2)$。在 $2$ 穿越；在 $-3$ 相切；结合纵截距与两端方向，平滑连接。

steps.title: (b) 由纵截距求比例
steps.body: 按指定重数写 $f(x)=A(x+1)^3(x-2)^2$；令 $x=0$ 得 $4A=4$，故 $A=1$。重数和正好为要求次数。

steps.title: (b) 次数、端点及截距
steps.body: 次数 5，首项系数 $1$，左下、右上。零点与重数：-1（重数3）；2（重数2）；横截距的横坐标为 $-1,2$；纵截距为 $(0,4)$。

steps.title: (b) 符号与草图
steps.body: 正值区间：$(-1,2)\cup(2,\infty)$；负值区间：$(-\infty,-1)$。在 $-1$ 穿越；在 $2$ 相切；结合纵截距与两端方向，平滑连接。

steps.title: (c) 由纵截距求比例
steps.body: 按指定重数写 $f(x)=A(x+2)^2(x-3)^2$；令 $x=0$ 得 $36A=-6$，故 $A=-1/6$。重数和正好为要求次数。

steps.title: (c) 次数、端点及截距
steps.body: 次数 4，首项系数 $-\frac{1}{6}$，两端向下。零点与重数：-2（重数2）；3（重数2）；横截距的横坐标为 $-2,3$；纵截距为 $(0,-6)$。

steps.title: (c) 符号与草图
steps.body: 正值区间：$\varnothing$；负值区间：$(-\infty,-2)\cup(-2,3)\cup(3,\infty)$。在 $-2,3$ 相切；结合纵截距与两端方向，平滑连接。

en.prompt: Determine the least-degree equation and sketch each polynomial function: (a) cubic with zeros $-3$ (multiplicity 2) and 2, y-intercept $-18$; (b) quintic with zeros $-1$ (multiplicity 3) and 2 (multiplicity 2), y-intercept 4; (c) quartic with negative leading coefficient, zeros $-2$ (multiplicity 2) and 3 (multiplicity 2), constant term $-6$.

steps.title: (a) Determine the scale
steps.body: Use the prescribed multiplicities: $f(x)=A(x+3)^2(x-2)$. At $x=0$, $-18A=-18$, giving $A=1$. The multiplicity sum equals the required degree.

steps.title: (a) Factor and find zeros
steps.body: $(x+3)^2(x-2)=(x+3)^2(x-2)$. Set each factor to zero: -3 (multiplicity 2); 2 (multiplicity 1).

steps.title: (a) Degree, ends and intercepts
steps.body: Degree 3, leading coefficient $1$: falls left and rises right. Zeros: -3 (multiplicity 2); 2 (multiplicity 1); x-intercepts have x-coordinates $-3,2$; y-intercept $(0,-18)$.

steps.title: (a) Signs and sketch
steps.body: Positive on $(2,\infty)$; negative on $(-\infty,-3)\cup(-3,2)$. Cross at $2$; touch at $-3$; join smoothly through the y-intercept with the stated end behaviour.

steps.title: (b) Determine the scale
steps.body: Use the prescribed multiplicities: $f(x)=A(x+1)^3(x-2)^2$. At $x=0$, $4A=4$, giving $A=1$. The multiplicity sum equals the required degree.

steps.title: (b) Factor and find zeros
steps.body: $(x+1)^3(x-2)^2=(x+1)^3(x-2)^2$. Set each factor to zero: -1 (multiplicity 3); 2 (multiplicity 2).

steps.title: (b) Degree, ends and intercepts
steps.body: Degree 5, leading coefficient $1$: falls left and rises right. Zeros: -1 (multiplicity 3); 2 (multiplicity 2); x-intercepts have x-coordinates $-1,2$; y-intercept $(0,4)$.

steps.title: (b) Signs and sketch
steps.body: Positive on $(-1,2)\cup(2,\infty)$; negative on $(-\infty,-1)$. Cross at $-1$; touch at $2$; join smoothly through the y-intercept with the stated end behaviour.

steps.title: (c) Determine the scale
steps.body: Use the prescribed multiplicities: $f(x)=A(x+2)^2(x-3)^2$. At $x=0$, $36A=-6$, giving $A=-1/6$. The multiplicity sum equals the required degree.

steps.title: (c) Factor and find zeros
steps.body: $-\frac16(x+2)^2(x-3)^2=-\frac16(x+2)^2(x-3)^2$. Set each factor to zero: -2 (multiplicity 2); 3 (multiplicity 2).

steps.title: (c) Degree, ends and intercepts
steps.body: Degree 4, leading coefficient $-\frac{1}{6}$: falls at both ends. Zeros: -2 (multiplicity 2); 3 (multiplicity 2); x-intercepts have x-coordinates $-2,3$; y-intercept $(0,-6)$.

steps.title: (c) Signs and sketch
steps.body: Positive on $\varnothing$; negative on $(-\infty,-2)\cup(-2,3)\cup(3,\infty)$. touch at $-2,3$; join smoothly through the y-intercept with the stated end behaviour.

exercises.prompt: 长方体宽为 $w$ cm，高比宽少2 cm，长比宽多4 cm。若体积的数值等于长度数值的8倍，求长方体的尺寸。

steps.title: 检验
steps.body: 宽4 cm、高2 cm、长8 cm；体积64 cm³，其数值为长度8的8倍。

exercises.answer: 宽4 cm，高2 cm，长8 cm。

en.prompt: The width of a rectangular prism is $w$ cm. Its height is 2 cm less than its width and its length is 4 cm more than its width. If the magnitude of its volume is 8 times the measure of its length, find the dimensions.

steps.title: Model with restrictions
steps.body: Height is $w-2$ and length is $w+4$, requiring $w>2$. Using the numerical measurements in the stated units, $w(w-2)(w+4)=8(w+4)$.

steps.title: Divide by the positive length and factor
steps.body: Since $w+4>0$, divide by it: $w(w-2)=8$, or $(w-4)(w+2)=0$. Only 4 of the roots 4 and $-2$ is admissible.

steps.title: Check
steps.body: Width 4 cm, height 2 cm, length 8 cm; volume 64 cm³ has numerical value 8 times the length measurement 8.

en.answer: Width 4 cm, height 2 cm, length 8 cm.

exercises.prompt: 三个连续奇整数的积为 $-105$，求这三个整数。

steps.title: 表示连续奇整数
steps.body: 令最小奇整数为 $n$，三数为 $n,n+2,n+4$，所以 $n(n+2)(n+4)=-105$。

en.prompt: Three consecutive odd integers have a product of $-105$. What are they?

steps.title: Represent consecutive odd integers
steps.body: Let the least odd integer be $n$. Then $n,n+2,n+4$ give $n(n+2)(n+4)=-105$.

steps.title: Factor and solve
steps.body: $n^3+6n^2+8n+105=(n+7)(n^2-n+15)=0$. The quadratic discriminant is $1-60=-59<0$, so $n=-7$.

steps.title: Check
steps.body: The integers $-7,-5,-3$ are consecutive odd integers and $(-7)(-5)(-3)=-105$.

exercises.prompt: 纪念碑由上下叠放的两个石灰岩正方体组成，小块放在大块上。总高5 m，露在外面的表面积为61 m²，求两块的尺寸。

steps.title: 表示边长与露出面积
steps.body: 设大块边长 $a$、小块边长 $b$，$a+b=5$ 且 $a\ge b>0$。地面底面不露出：大块四侧加露出的顶面为 $5a^2-b^2$；小块四侧与顶面为 $5b^2$。总面积 $5a^2+4b^2=61$。

exercises.answer: 大块3 m × 3 m × 3 m，小块2 m × 2 m × 2 m。

en.prompt: A monument consists of two cubical limestone blocks, the smaller resting on the larger. Total height is 5 m and exposed surface area is 61 m². Determine the dimensions of both blocks.

steps.title: Express side lengths and exposed area
steps.body: Let the sides be $a$ (large) and $b$ (small), so $a+b=5$ and $a\ge b>0$. The bottom on the ground is not exposed. The large block contributes $5a^2-b^2$ and the small one $5b^2$, giving $5a^2+4b^2=61$.

steps.title: Apply the size condition and check
steps.body: $a\ge b$ requires $a\ge2.5$, excluding $13/9$. Thus $a=3,b=2$; height $3+2=5$ and exposed area $5(9)+4(4)=61$ m².

en.answer: Large block 3 m × 3 m × 3 m; small block 2 m × 2 m × 2 m.

exercises.prompt: Olutie 跟祖母学习用 stroud 羊毛布和毛毡制作传统因纽特壁挂。她为正方形壁挂制作正方形外框。图中内侧边长为 $x$ in，带边框的外侧边长为 $x^2-12$ in；边框需要144 in²毛毡。(a) 写出边框面积的多项式模型。(b) 求壁挂尺寸。(c) 求边框尺寸。
exercises.answer: (a) $A=x^4-25x^2+144$；(b) 5 in × 5 in；(c) 外框13 in × 13 in，四周宽4 in，内开口5 in × 5 in。

en.prompt: Olutie is learning from her grandmother to make traditional Inuit wall hangings from stroud and felt. She makes a square border for her square wall hanging. The diagram shows inner side $x$ in and outer side $x^2-12$ in. She needs 144 in² of felt for the border. (a) Write a polynomial expression for the border area. (b) Find the wall-hanging dimensions. (c) Find the border dimensions.

steps.title: (a) Difference of areas
steps.body: Border area $A(x)=(x^2-12)^2-x^2=x^4-25x^2+144$ in². Require $x>0$ and $x^2-12>x$.

steps.title: (b) Set the area to 144
steps.body: $x^4-25x^2+144=144$ gives $x^2(x-5)(x+5)=0$. Among $0,5,-5$, only 5 gives positive sides with the outside larger than the inside.

steps.title: (b)(c) Recover dimensions
steps.body: The inner hanging is 5 in × 5 in; the outer side is $5^2-12=13$ in. The border width is $(13-5)/2=4$ in. Check: $13^2-5^2=169-25=144$ in².

en.answer: (a) $A=x^4-25x^2+144$; (b) 5 in × 5 in; (c) outer border 13 in × 13 in, width 4 in all around, inner opening 5 in × 5 in.

exercises.prompt: 四个连续整数的积为840，求这四个整数。

en.prompt: Four consecutive integers have a product of 840. What are the integers?

steps.title: Represent the product and substitute
steps.body: Let the least integer be $n$. Then $n(n+1)(n+2)(n+3)=840$. Set $t=n^2+3n$, so $n(n+3)=t$ and $(n+1)(n+2)=t+2$.

steps.title: Give and check both sets
steps.body: The product of $4,5,6,7$ is 840. So is that of $-7,-6,-5,-4$. Both sets are consecutive integers.

exercises.prompt: 写出一个三次函数，横截距的横坐标为 $\sqrt3,-\sqrt3,1$，纵截距为 $-1$。

steps.title: 展开核查
steps.body: $f(x)=-\frac13(x^2-3)(x-1)=-\frac13x^3+\frac13x^2+x-1$，常数项为 $-1$，三个指定数均使某因子为0。

en.prompt: Write a cubic function with x-intercepts $\sqrt3,-\sqrt3,1$ and y-intercept $-1$.

steps.title: Expand and check
steps.body: $f(x)=-\frac13(x^2-3)(x-1)=-\frac13x^3+\frac13x^2+x-1$. Its constant is $-1$, and all three specified values make a factor zero.

exercises.prompt: 方程 $2x^3+3x^2-23x-12=0$ 的根按从小到大记为 $a,b,c$。求以 $a+b,\frac ab,ab$ 为根的方程。

en.prompt: The roots of $2x^3+3x^2-23x-12=0$ are $a,b,c$, from least to greatest. Determine the equation with roots $a+b,\frac ab,ab$.

exercises.prompt: (a) 预测 $y=x^3-x^2$ 与 $y=(x-2)^3-(x-2)^2$ 图像的关系。(b) 用技术画出两者以验证预测。(c) 分解两函数并求横截距。

steps.title: (a) 识别自变量替换
steps.body: 令 $f(x)=x^3-x^2$，第二个函数为 $g(x)=f(x-2)$；图像整体右移2，无其他变换。

exercises.answer: (a)(b) 右移2；(c) 原函数零点0（二重）、1，第二函数零点2（二重）、3。

en.prompt: (a) Predict the relationship between $y=x^3-x^2$ and $y=(x-2)^3-(x-2)^2$. (b) Graph both with technology to verify. (c) Factor each to determine its x-intercepts.

steps.title: (a) Identify the input substitution
steps.body: Let $f(x)=x^3-x^2$. The second function is $g(x)=f(x-2)$, a translation right 2 with no other transformation.

steps.title: (b) Compare corresponding points
steps.body: $f(0)=0,f(1)=0,f(2)=4$; $g(2)=0,g(3)=0,g(4)=4$. Every x-coordinate gains 2; the plotted curves have the same shape.

en.answer: (a)(b) Translate right 2; (c) original zeros 0 (double), 1; second zeros 2 (double), 3.

exercises.prompt: 球形漂浮浮标半径1 m，密度为海水的 $\frac14$。已知球冠体积 $V_{cap}=\frac{\pi x}{6}(3a^2+x^2)$，求浮标下沉到海水中的深度（图中 $x$）。

steps.title: 用浮力确定排水体积
steps.body: 漂浮时排开的海水重量等于浮标重量。密度比为 $1/4$，故排水体积为球体积的 $1/4$：$V_{cap}=\frac14\cdot\frac43\pi(1)^3=\pi/3$ m³。深度范围 $0<x<2$。

steps.title: 求有效数值根
steps.body: 令其等于 $\pi/3$，得 $x^2(3-x)=1$，即 $x^3-3x^2+1=0$。用图像或二分法，在 $0<x<2$ 得 $x\approx0.6527036$ m。该区间球冠体积随深度严格增加，故有效根唯一；其他实根约为 $-0.5321,2.8794$，均在范围外。

exercises.answer: 下沉深度 $x\approx0.653$ m。

en.prompt: A spherical floating buoy has radius 1 m and density $\frac14$ that of sea water. Given the spherical-cap volume $V_{cap}=\frac{\pi x}{6}(3a^2+x^2)$, to what depth does it sink in sea water (the labelled $x$)?

steps.title: Use buoyancy to find displaced volume
steps.body: A floating object displaces its own weight of water. Density ratio $1/4$ means submerged volume is $1/4$ of the sphere: $V_{cap}=\frac14\cdot\frac43\pi(1)^3=\pi/3$ m³. The depth satisfies $0<x<2$.

steps.title: Eliminate $a$ with the right triangle
steps.body: The diagram gives $a^2+(1-x)^2=1$, so $a^2=2x-x^2$. Thus $V_{cap}=\frac{\pi x}{6}[3(2x-x^2)+x^2]=\frac\pi3x^2(3-x)$.

steps.title: Find the admissible numerical root
steps.body: Equate to $\pi/3$: $x^2(3-x)=1$, or $x^3-3x^2+1=0$. Graphing or bisection gives $x\approx0.6527036$ m in $0<x<2$. Cap volume increases strictly with depth in this interval, so the admissible root is unique; the other real roots, approximately $-0.5321,2.8794$, lie outside it.

steps.title: Check and state units
steps.body: $0.6527036^2(3-0.6527036)\approx1$, giving displaced volume approximately $\pi/3$ m³. The buoy sinks about 0.653 m.

en.answer: Submerged depth $x\approx0.653$ m.

exercises.prompt: 为什么把多项式写成因式分解形式很有用？用例子解释。

steps.title: 方便解方程与判符号
steps.body: 方程 $x^3-3x+2=0$ 化成零乘积；平方因子非负，所以除零点外，函数符号与 $x+2$ 相同。这些信息帮助勾图。

exercises.answer: 因式形式可直接求零点、重数，解方程、判符号并帮助画图。

en.prompt: Why is it useful to express a polynomial in factored form? Explain with examples.

steps.title: Read zeros and multiplicities
steps.body: For example, $x^3-3x+2=(x-1)^2(x+2)$ immediately gives zeros 1 (double) and $-2$ (simple). Thus intercepts are $(1,0),(-2,0)$, touching at 1 and crossing at $-2$.

steps.title: Solve equations and determine signs
steps.body: The equation $x^3-3x+2=0$ becomes a zero product. The square factor is nonnegative, so away from the zeros the sign is that of $x+2$. These features guide a sketch.

en.answer: Factored form reveals zeros and multiplicities, solves equations, determines signs and guides sketches.

exercises.prompt: 说明根、零点与横截距分别是什么，以及它们之间的关系。

steps.title: 分别定义
steps.body: 根是满足方程 $f(x)=0$ 的数；零点是令函数值为0的输入数；横截距是图像与横轴相交的点，形式为 $(a,0)$。

steps.title: 举例联系
steps.body: 若 $f(x)=(x-2)(x+1)$，根和零点为2、$-1$，横截距是 $(2,0),(-1,0)$。根与零点等于横截距的横坐标。

exercises.answer: 根与零点是数；对应横截距是以该数为横坐标、纵坐标为0的点。

en.prompt: Describe what is meant by a root, a zero and an x-intercept. How are they related?

steps.title: Define each term
steps.body: A root is a number satisfying the equation $f(x)=0$. A zero is an input giving function value 0. An x-intercept is a point where the graph meets the x-axis, written $(a,0)$.

steps.title: Connect them with an example
steps.body: For $f(x)=(x-2)(x+1)$, roots and zeros are 2 and $-1$, while intercepts are $(2,0),(-1,0)$. Roots and zeros equal the x-coordinates of x-intercepts.

en.answer: Roots and zeros are numbers; corresponding x-intercepts are points with those x-coordinates and y-coordinate 0.

exercises.prompt: 怎样从图像判断零点的重数可能是1、偶数，还是大于1的奇数？

steps.title: 重数1
steps.body: 图像在零点处一般以非零斜率穿越横轴，局部像非水平直线。

steps.title: 偶重数
steps.body: 曲线在横轴处相切折返，不改变符号；重数2的局部形状像抛物线，较高偶重数更平坦。

steps.title: 大于1的奇重数
steps.body: 图像仍穿越横轴并变号，但在零点处平坦，类似 $y=x^3$；仅凭一般草图难以分辨3、5等具体次数。

exercises.answer: 1：非平坦穿越；偶数：相切折返；大于1的奇数：平坦穿越。

en.prompt: How can you tell from a graph whether a zero has multiplicity 1, an even number, or an odd number greater than 1?

steps.title: Multiplicity 1
steps.body: The curve crosses the axis with nonzero slope, locally resembling a nonhorizontal line.

steps.title: Even multiplicity
steps.body: The curve touches the axis and turns back without changing sign. Multiplicity 2 locally resembles a parabola; higher even multiplicities are flatter.

steps.title: Odd multiplicity greater than 1
steps.body: The curve crosses and changes sign but flattens at the zero, like $y=x^3$. A sketch alone may not distinguish multiplicities 3,5 and so on.

en.answer: 1: nonflat crossing; even: touch and turn; odd greater than 1: flattened crossing.

en.prompt: Mini Lab: Apply prior knowledge to predict translations, stretches and reflections of $y=a(b(x-h))^n+k$ and its graphs. Step 1: Graph each set on one set of axes and sketch in your notebook. A: $y=x^3,y=x^3+2,y=x^3-2$. B: $y=x^4,y=(x+2)^4,y=(x-2)^4$. (a) Compare A: for any constant $k$, describe the relationship between $y=x^3$ and $y=x^3+k$. (b) Compare B: for any constant $h$, describe the relationship between $y=x^4$ and $y=(x-h)^4$. Step 2: Describe the roles of $h,k$ in the general form. Step 3: Graph each set on shared axes and sketch. C: $y=x^3,y=3x^3,y=-3x^3$. D: $y=x^4,y=\frac13x^4,y=-\frac13x^4$. (a) Compare C: for any integer $a$, describe $y=x^3$ versus $y=ax^3$. (b) Compare D: for rational $a$ with $-1<a<0$ or $0<a<1$, describe $y=x^4$ versus $y=ax^4$. Step 4: Graph each set on shared axes and sketch. E: $y=x^3,y=(3x)^3,y=(-3x)^3$. F: $y=x^4,y=(\frac13x)^4,y=(-\frac13x)^4$. (a) Compare E: for any integer $b$, describe $y=x^3$ versus $y=(bx)^3$. (b) Compare F: for rational $b$ with $-1<b<0$ or $0<b<1$, describe $y=x^4$ versus $y=(bx)^4$. Step 5: Describe the roles of $a,b$ in the general form.

steps.title: 1(a) Set A: vertical translations
steps.body: Start with $(-1,-1),(0,0),(1,1)$. Adding 2 gives $(-1,1),(0,2),(1,3)$; subtracting 2 gives $(-1,-3),(0,-2),(1,-1)$. In general $y=x^3+k$ maps $(x,y)\mapsto(x,y+k)$, up $k$ (down if negative).

steps.title: 1(b) Set B: horizontal translations
steps.body: $y=(x+2)^4$ is left 2 with minimum $(-2,0)$; $y=(x-2)^4$ is right 2 with minimum $(2,0)$. Generally $(x,y)\mapsto(x+h,y)$: right $h$ (left if negative).

steps.title: 2: Summarize $h,k$
steps.body: In $y=a[b(x-h)]^n+k$, stretch and reflect, then translate horizontally by $h$ and vertically by $k$. The input uses the opposite sign for $h$; the output uses the same sign for $k$.

steps.title: 3(a) Set C: vertical scaling
steps.body: From $(1,1)$ on $y=x^3$, $3x^3$ gives $(1,3)$ and $-3x^3$ gives $(1,-3)$. Generally multiply outputs by $a$, a vertical scale $|a|$, with x-axis reflection for $a<0$. $a=1$ is unchanged, $a=-1$ reflects only, and $a=0$ degenerates to $y=0$.

steps.title: 3(b) Set D: compression and reflection
steps.body: At $x=1$, $x^4,\frac13x^4,-\frac13x^4$ have values $1,1/3,-1/3$. For $0<|a|<1$, the vertical scale is $|a|$; reflect in the x-axis when $a<0$.

steps.title: 4(a) Set E: horizontal scaling
steps.body: Point $(1,1)$ maps to $(1/3,1)$ for $(3x)^3$ and $(-1/3,1)$ for $(-3x)^3$. For integer $b\ne0$, the horizontal scale is $1/|b|$, with y-axis reflection if $b<0$. $|b|>1$ compresses, $b=1$ is unchanged, $b=-1$ only reflects, and $b=0$ gives $y=0$ so the division-by-$b$ map cannot be used.

steps.title: 4(b) Set F: horizontal stretching
steps.body: For $0<|b|<1$, horizontal scale $1/|b|>1$. Both $b=1/3$ and $b=-1/3$ give $y=x^4/81$; $(1,1)$ maps to $(3,1)$ or $(-3,1)$. The even parent is symmetric about the y-axis, so the two transformed curves coincide.

steps.title: 5: Summarize $a,b$ and check graphs
steps.body: $a$ controls vertical scale $|a|$ and x-axis reflection. Nonzero $b$ controls horizontal scale $1/|b|$ and y-axis reflection. The full map is $(x,y)\mapsto(x/b+h,ay+k)$. The six shared-axis plots below agree with the corresponding points and directions.

en.answer: $k$: vertical translation; $h$: horizontal translation; $a$: vertical scaling and x-axis reflection; $b\ne0$: horizontal scale $1/|b|$ and y-axis reflection. All six graph sets, comparisons and zero-parameter exceptions are given above.
